Label: return value check

Label: return value check

rule.Description: X509_cmp_time() and X509_cmp_current_time() return -1 if B<asn1_time> is earlier than, or equal to, B<in_tm> (resp. current time), and 1 otherwise. These methods return 0 on error.
Label: return value check

rule.Description: X509_cmp_time() and X509_cmp_current_time() return -1 if B<asn1_time> is earlier than, or equal to, B<in_tm> (resp. current time), and 1 otherwise. These methods return 0 on error.
Label: return value check

rule.Description: X509_cmp_timeframe() returns 0 if B<vpm> is not NULL and the verification parameters do not contain B<X509_V_FLAG_USE_CHECK_TIME> but do contain B<X509_V_FLAG_NO_CHECK_TIME>. Otherwise it returns 1 if the end time is not NULL and the reference time (which has determined as stated above) is past the end time, -1 if the start time is not NULL and the reference time is before, else 0 to indicate that the reference time is in range (implying that the end time is not before the start time if both are present).
Label: return value check
